title: The Casserole Ledger (Part 2)
description: Earl the deacon is still on Nadia's doorstep, the forty-one meals still uncleared. Tonight the parish escalates from collateral to estate planning, and Barry, logged for accepting one church donut on air, opens his very first blessing summary.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Welcome back to Snazzie FM. When we left off, Nadia owed the St. Bevin's Care Committee forty-one meals, and a deacon named Earl was standing on her welcome mat. <p:0.3> Earl, you still out there, buddy?

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: Evening. <p:0.3> I never left. <p:0.3> I have a thermos and a folding chair. The ledger taught me patience.

lines.speaker: caller-nadia
lines.text: He brought a CHAIR. <p:0.3> I gave you the pan, Earl. I slid it under the door. Why are you still HERE?

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: The pan settled the interest, dear. <p:0.3> We're collecting on the principal now.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: The principal was ONE lasagna, Earl. One. <p:0.3> A man cannot stand on a porch for one lasagna.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Oh, Barry, you sweet thing. <p:0.3> A man can stand anywhere a blessing is owed. That's in the bylaws.

lines.speaker: caller-nadia
lines.text: Okay. <p:0.3> Fine. I'll cook the forty-one. I'll do it tonight. How do I clear the principal?

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: You don't clear the principal, dear. <p:0.3> You name a beneficiary. The debt has to go somewhere when you go. <p:0.3> Mine's going to a nephew who doesn't know yet.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: It's INHERITABLE?

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Of course, Barry. Kindness outlives us all. <p:0.3> That's the comforting part.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: A blessing that follows the bloodline. <p:0.3> Folks, that's a love so big it skips a generation.

lines.speaker: caller-nadia
lines.text: I am twenty-nine and I have a CASSEROLE MORTGAGE!

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: Refinancing is available. <p:0.3> See Mildred about a second dish.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, can we move on? I'm getting uncomfortable. <p:0.3> Also, what is this envelope on my desk.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Open it, dear.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: It's... it's a blessing summary. <p:0.3> With my name on it. <p:0.3> Why do I have a balance, I've never called your church.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: Did you accept anything, dear? <p:0.3> Anything at all?

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: I... a woman dropped off donuts for the studio this morning. I had ONE. The maple one.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: That was a parish donut, Barry. <p:0.3> Box of twelve, donated. You accepted on behalf of the building.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: On behalf of the... it was a DONUT.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: The donut was the principal, dear. <p:0.3> What does the summary say it became?

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: It says I owe the parish... a fundraiser, a flatbed truck, and a stained glass window. <p:0.3> Off ONE MAPLE DONUT?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: A maple donut that became a window. <p:0.3> Barry, you're a stained glass philanthropist and you didn't even know it.

lines.speaker: caller-nadia
lines.text: Welcome to the LEDGER, Barry!

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: I have his address. <p:0.3> It's the radio station.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Don't you read MY name out of that book, Earl!

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Star.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: Novena.

lines.speaker: caller-nadia
lines.text: Beneficiary!

lines.speaker: caller-winston
lines.text: Window.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, there's a van pulling up outside the STATION.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And that's our show. <p:0.3> A reminder, folks, that no good deed goes uncollected, and neither does breakfast. <p:0.4> Barry, go answer the door. Earl doesn't like to knock twice.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: ...And bring the napkin, dear. The napkin accrues.
